T2T.definition: arithmetic median of the 30 per-window interval counts; not a selected window

chr1_static_geometry.binary_count: end comparisons in the documented lower_bound plus body entries after its returned index; not unique entries or CPU time
chr1_static_geometry.intervals: zero-based half-open [start,start+size); lower_bound finds first exclusive mask end > request start
chr1_static_geometry.linear_count: all body entries from index0 through first mask start>=request end, inclusive; no stopping entry if exhausted
chr1_static_geometry.quantile_definition: nearest rank: requests p50 index499 and p99 index989; these rank geometry counts, not latency

limitations: Static interval geometry only: no elapsed-time attribution, causal percentage, cache simulation, codec execution or new forecast; original P1-P3 unchanged.
mask_table_bytes_definition: 8 bytes per stored interval (uint32 start and size); excludes other archive/index bytes and is not RSS

mechanism_source.source_lookup: linear scan starts at index0; casefix only removes the skip-N guard from the lowercase loop
